messages.en: Meow!!!!!!
What are you doing?
Hayeon got off work and took a shower.
It's almost my vacation too ㅠㅠ
Finally...!!!
Seriously, ever since we started preparing for promotions,
I haven't had a proper break at all.
I've been thinking about what to do during my vacation.
Maybe go on a trip with my grandma, grandpa, and cousins,
or travel with my family.
Honestly, I was planning to just sleep the whole time,
but that feels like such a waste.
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎ
Are you going to film a Set Log during your vacation???
Actually...
I filmed one while shooting Magical Girl.
But I didn't know how to save it.
So I just became someone who filmed really hard...
Seriously, how do you save it?
I'm slowly falling behind the trends now.
It's already been half a year, right?
In another six months I'll be 21.
How am I already turning 21?
What have I even done...
I heard the '07 liners got friendship rings.
Oh right!
I left mine in the bathroom after washing up.
I almost forgot it.
Who suggested it?
I did.
Kim Chaewon suggested we go look for rings.
While we were looking around, I said, "Let's get matching friendship rings, like middle schoolers."
I even picked the design myself.
I'm going to the fansign tomorrow,
so I'll wear it.
Did everyone pay for their own ring?
Of course. Things like that should be clear.
Whenever we go out together,
we always settle the bill afterward.

messages.ko: 애들이랑 맨날 같이 밥먹고 모이고 하니까
messages.en: We eat together and hang out all the time,
so I think it's about time we took a little break before meeting again.
We're basically family now.
Relationships last longer
when you don't see each other too often.
We've been together way too much.
But the '07 line has become so much closer,
and I really love that.
I deserve a lot of credit for that.
If you're an '07 line fan, you should thank me.
Honestly though, Hyerin is our leader.
So Hyerin should buy us a meal sometime.
Then what's the benefit of being the leader?
More expenses. ❤️
Why won't the photos send??
Ta-da.
These were when we ate sashimi and took a walk by the ocean.
The video from then is so cute,
so once we can send videos, I'll send it to you.
Oops, I accidentally sent the same picture twice.
It's a bug.
Walking by the ocean at night was really nice.
Who took those pictures?
Yeonji took the photos.
Soomin filmed the videos.
And Yooyeon unnie was off wandering around taking selfies.

messages.ko: 부럽네 연지가 사진찍고 숨숨이가 영상찍어주는 삶이라니
messages.en: I'm jealous... having Yeonji take your pictures and Soomin film your videos...
I like my life too.
It feels like I have all the pretty girls.
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ
Right. There's one in the mirror too.
Unnie, recommend something delicious.
My love.
My love. 😙
Oh, and...
I bought a new body scrub wash,
and it smells so good.
My quality of life has gone up.
I think it's Belman...?
I think.
It's kind of a floral scent, but really soft.
Did wearing the ring remind you because you went to pick it up?

messages.ko: 저거 보러 간김에 끼고 왔어 ㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎ
messages.en: I put it on while I was there. ㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎ

messages.ko: 먼저 하자 해놓고 반지 에 좀 무관심한 것 같은데ㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: You were the one who suggested getting the rings, but you seem kind of uninterested in them.ㅋㅋㅋ
I've always hated wearing accessories.

messages.ko: 아무것도 없이 깨끗한게 이쁘다고 생각하는 사람인데
messages.en: I think people look prettier when they're simple, without anything on.
But friendship rings have meaning.
I used to think earrings weren't that pretty.
Turns out it was only because I didn't like how they looked on me.
I don't really care if other people wear them.
When I see earrings,
it just kind of gives me the feeling of something your mom got pierced for you when you were in elementary school,
and you just wore them around.
That's just the feeling I get.
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅎㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ
Doesn't getting your ears pierced hurt?
I've never pierced mine.
Then I guess you haven't pierced your nose either?
Well... when I was little, I pierced it once with an Onion Ring.
And my nails with Bugles.
Honestly,

messages.ko: 패션이랑 트렌드 잘 쫓아가는 스타일이 아니였는데
messages.en: I was never someone who naturally followed fashion or trends.

messages.ko: 직업이 직업이다 보니 점점 노력하고 해서
messages.en: But because of my job, I've been making more of an effort,
and I've gotten better at it.

messages.ko: 진짜 트레이닝복 세트로 여러개 사서 돌려입고
messages.en: I used to just buy several matching tracksuits
and rotate wearing those.

messages.ko: 웬지 지금도 연습실로 갈때 그럴거 같아..
messages.en: Somehow I feel like you still dress like that when you go to the practice room...
I do.
It's kind of amazing seeing the members
come to practice all dressed up and fashionable.
Wow...
I just nodded off.
How did that happen?
I have a morning fansign tomorrow,
so I should head to bed now.
Sleep well.
Haranghae ❤️❤️
